ops.title: Audit rable parser re-pin: possible lost prefix enumeration in control flow
ops.description: The a3c57df rable parser swap left 27 test failures on main (raw now retains redirects/heredocs/control-flow wrapping; some control-flow cases changed parts/prefixes). Owner-approved decision on 2026-07-22: re-pin all 27 to current rable behavior as-is to unblock CI and the release. Most re-pins are cosmetic raw-string updates, but the empty-prefixes cases (e.g. test_command_prefixes[if-condition-then-else]) look like genuinely lost enumeration, now enshrined by the re-pin. This task is the audit debt from that decision.

ops.text: For each of the 27 re-pinned expectations in tests/test_command.py, tests/test_command_parity.py, tests/test_splice_parity.py: confirm the pinned rable behavior is intended, or fix the parser; specifically command prefixes inside if/for bodies now return () where the tree-sitter parser returned symbol tuples like ('grep','echo','echo') — verify this is not lost functionality
